items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: Reels off season-high 171 yards
items.text:
Smith-Njigba gathered in eight of 10 targets for 171 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 21-13 win at Las Vegas.

items.title: Tyler Warren: Next to nothing with three touches
items.text:
Warren rushed once for three yards and brought in two of three targets for one yard in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Tops 100 scrimmage yards against Titans
items.text:
Tuten carried the ball 26 times for 88 yards and a touchdown and caught three of four targets for 25 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over Tennessee.

items.title: Drake Maye: Expected to miss time
items.text:
Maye (ankle) will undergo additional testing, but the Patriots expect him to be out for a while, SNF on NBC reports.

items.title: Trevor Lawrence: Tosses three TDs in big win
items.text:
Lawrence completed 25 of 35 passes for 352 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans. He added 27 yards on four carries.

items.title: Denzel Boston: Ineffective playing through toe injury
items.text:
Boston caught just one pass for 16 yards on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.

items.title: Tank Dell: Three receptions in Week 10 loss
items.text:
Dell brought in three of four targets for 21 yards and rushed once for no gain in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

items.title: Xavier Hutchinson: Records TD grab in loss
items.text:
Hutchinson brought in four of nine targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Limping following loss Sunday
items.text:
Brown (hamstring) was spotted limping out of the locker room following Sunday's Week 10 loss to Detroit, Andrew Callahan of the Boston Herald reports.
